## Learning Goals {background-color="#1B4332"}

*Objectifs d'apprentissage*

By the end of today, you can:

- Explain indirect resistance: recruiting a third party (a natural
  enemy of the herbivore) instead of fighting the herbivore directly
- Recognize and name the main guilds of natural enemies (predators,
  parasitoids, pathogens), in English and French
- Distinguish two ways plants recruit natural enemies: standing
  **rewards** (food, shelter) vs. conditional **signals** (HIPVs)
- Describe the classic HIPV discovery experiment and trace how the
  field has developed since
